title: App pages: a full-width list block caps its rows (default 5) with 查看全部, and a tabbed list block caps each tab — the Sales Home lists 21 leads with a horizontal overflow
body:
## Source

Walked on 2026-10-27 on HotCRM's Sales Home page (`/page/sales_home_page`) at 955 px: the tabbed block 我的线索 / 我的进行中商机 / 我的待办任务 renders the full object list — 21 rows, `#` column, every column, a horizontal scrollbar — under the KPI grid. objectstack-ai/objectui#12703 gave narrow list blocks a compact posture; a full-width block in a page still behaves like the object list page.

## Target

1. A list block inside a page caps its rows at `limit` (default 5) and ends with 「查看全部 N 条 →」 to the object list with the block's view; no `#` column, no toolbar, the first four columns of the view, the rest dropped (not scrolled).
2. A tabbed list block applies the cap per tab and shows each tab's count in the tab label.
3. The page designer exposes `limit` on the block.

## File surface

The page renderer's list block in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/` (the same surface objectstack-ai/objectui#12703 edited), the page designer block properties, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: a full-width list block renders 5 rows and the link; a tabbed block caps each tab.
2. Screenshot of Sales Home at 1280 px.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-27 fifth review: objectstack main `f9867020c6` (Object UI now under `ui/`), HotCRM `1f3f8880` on platform 18.2.0 (the published console at `/_console`, a fresh dev database), the maintainer's browser pane at 955 × 452 (zh-CN), plus cloud staging (the control-plane home and the test1016 tenant's build chat). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed by where the fix lands, verbatim: 「全部立卡，按落点分仓；#25943 让车道正常派发。」</sub>
